note: Only what each lab has published. null means not publicly documented. No latency figures are included because none of these labs publish comparable, independently measured numbers.

models.name: Block Dessa
models.architecture: End-to-end speech-to-speech: audio in, audio out, no text
models.training_data: Only human conversation audio; no text, no pretrained models
models.local_inference: Faster than real time on a MacBook Pro M4 Max or better (per Block)

models.name: Sesame CSM
models.architecture: Llama backbone plus audio decoder; speech from text and context
models.training_data: About 1M hours of transcribed public audio, mostly English
models.local_inference: CSM-1B base model runs on your own GPU
models.availability: Research preview app; CSM-1B code on GitHub

models.name: OpenAI GPT-Live-1
models.architecture: Full-duplex voice model; delegates reasoning to a backend model

models.name: Kyutai Moshi
models.architecture: Speech-text model: 7B Temporal Transformer, Depth Transformer, Mimi codec
models.training_data: Helium text LLM init; 7M audio hours; Fisher; synthetic dialogues
models.availability: Open source on GitHub and Hugging Face; demo at moshi.chat
